proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Equal Shareholder Voting
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, James McRitchie, Myra K. Young and the NorthStar Asset Management Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to initiate a recapitalization plan so all outstanding stock has one vote per share, including negotiation with Class B holders to relinquish preexisting rights.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Lobbying Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing Google's direct and indirect and grassroots lobbying policies, payments, and oversight decision-making processes.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Political Contributions Report
proposals.proponent: Clean Yield Asset Management, on behalf of John Fedor-Cunningham
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semiannually updated report disclosing the company's political contributions and expenditures, including recipients, amounts, and decision-makers.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding The Adoption of a Majority Vote Standard For The Election of Directors
proposals.proponent: The Firefighters' Pension System of the City of Kansas City, Missouri, Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend governance documents so directors are elected by a majority of votes cast, retaining plurality for contested elections.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding an Independent Chairman of the Board Policy
proposals.proponent: The Marco Consulting Group Trust I
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a policy that the board chairman be an independent director who has not previously been an executive officer of the company.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Gender Pay
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, Ann Alexander, Michael Baldwin, Margherita Baldwin, and the Sustainability Group on behalf of the William B. Perkins Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report by October 2016 on the company's policies and goals to reduce the gender pay gap.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.
